dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Adds concrete decision‑tree logic, high‑risk port registry, CIDR /7 public classification, prefix‑list inspection steps, CVSS‑style severity mapping and compliance control cross‑reference – details a senior CloudOps engineer would learn. Missing coverage of IPv6 protocol‑specific nuances (e.g., ICMPv6 type handling) prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes AWS‑specific mindset (stateful SG, worst‑rule aggregation) and concrete pre‑flight CLI safety steps. Lacks an explicit procedure for deduplicating or reconciling overlapping CIDR rules, so not fully comprehensive.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Extensive NEVER list with concrete reasons (SSH public, all‑ports, prefix‑list, CIDR /7, ephemerals, etc.). Does not include a NEVER rule for exposing HTTP (port 80) without an ALB, a minor omission.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description clearly states when to invoke, and activation keywords are exhaustive. No explicit "when NOT to invoke" clause, leading to a small deduction.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered (summary, mindset, process, tables, anti‑patterns, references). Some deep reference tables appear early, causing slight cognitive overload.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive remediation is tightly constrained with backup, additive‑change guidance, rollback verification, and safety checks; creative analysis is left free. Calibration is spot‑on.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows the established CloudOps auditor pattern with clear sections (frontmatter, mindset, process, anti‑patterns, references, output format, safety checks, remediation).

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working pseudocode, CLI commands, output format, and worked examples; an agent can execute end‑to‑end. Missing explicit handling for protocol -1 combined with prefix‑list sources and IPv6 ICMP specifics, so not flawless.
